name: The Gold and Glory Tour, Week 1

date.source: Its own newsdesk of 6 October 2007 and the show's own information page (bell time 10:00am, General Admission $5.00).

notes: Staged at the National Guard Armory before a crowd its own transcript puts at 276. Its own closing line calls it "the first ever American Wrestling Alliance show." Named on the page but not registered: the ringside attendant, the referees and the security guards.

matches.note: Johnny Legend bridges a full nelson suplex for the three count after a hurricanrana and a missed moonsault; Greatness runs in afterwards and powerbombs him before security and a second referee pull him off.
Half Sliced and Rush against a three-man team billed out of Mexico and Columbia; Rush takes the fall with a frog splash off the top rope while his partners hold off the break-up.

matches.stipulation: American Wrestling Alliance Heavyweight Championship Tournament Qualifier
matches.note: Announced on the page as a qualifier for the Heavyweight Championship tournament. Matt Fury blocks the Independent Clash, hits three consecutive powerbombs and finishes with the Fury Bomb; the two shake hands.

appearances.note: Runs in after the opening match and powerbombs Johnny Legend.
Opens the show for the ownership group and returns to make the supercard announcement and introduce Ninja K.
Walks out during the special announcement and is announced for a singles match on The Conclusion 2007.
